# Fine-step stock under coarse rule cadences, intra-span block slack, and the pace–margin sandwich

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`paced-stock-and-cadence-margin-sandwich` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](paced-stock-and-cadence-margin-sandwich.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Fine-step stock evolution under coarse Pace rule cadences satisfies intra-span block slack bounds, yields feasibility when initial buffer covers the Pace identification lag (2N - 1) plus safe-headroom, and proves unrecoverable collapse when initial margin falls short.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Fine-step evolution under coarse rule cadence: under strict sampling σ and ReadAtSpanEnd σ reads, pacedCourse holds its active rule fixed across every Becoming.span σ j while advancing the unit-level state along LineOnAStock.step (paced_held_on_span) and updates the rule only across span boundaries (paced_block_transition). <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. For intra-span transport: Becoming.Strict σ, ReadAtSpanEnd σ reads, CoveredByBlocks, reach-scoped stepDrop ≤ block slack * (L - 1), and explicit choice hypothesis (if transporting non-deterministic Keepable).
- For Pace–Margin feasibility/impossibility: Pace.StretchFixes / 2N - 1 ≤ L, RegimeMargin Short/Meets/Keeps hypotheses, FromNothing/AtMost bounds, and explicit buffer bounds relative to H₂ + y₂ and H₁.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That real training, governance, or feedback cadences operate with exact span-end rule reads, deterministic lasso dynamics, or fixed H₁/H₂ bounds.
- A global bidirectional equivalence for Frame.blocks Keepable without choice/determinism, or for fixed slack without realizesDrop. Witness: `Becoming.PacedStock.SlackShortWitness.witness_summary`.
